description_en: Calls the DeleteMetricRuleBlackList operation to delete alert blacklist policies
description_zh: 调用DeleteMetricRuleBlackList接口删除报警黑名单策略
name: DeleteMetricRuleBlackList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert blacklist policy. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 50 IDs.

For information about how to obtain the ID of an alert blacklist policy, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457257.html.

This parameter also supports JSON Array format, for example: `["a9ad2ac2-3ed9-11ed-b878-0242ac12****","5cb8a9a4-198f-4651-a353-f8b28788****"]`
parameters.help_zh:
报警黑名单策略的ID。多个ID之间以半角逗号（,）分隔，且不能超过50个。

关于如何获取报警黑名单策略的ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457257.html。

该参数也支持JSON Array格式，例如：`["a9ad2ac2-3ed9-11ed-b878-0242ac12****","5cb8a9a4-198f-4651-a353-f8b28788****"]`
parameters.name: id

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code.

200 indicates success

Count.description_en: The number of alert blacklist policies that were successfully deleted
Count.description_zh: 成功删除的报警黑名单策略的数量

Message.example: The specified resource is not found.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
